data.name: Mann
data.gender_notes: Mann is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mann is derived from Sanskrit, which means 'mind' or 'intellect'. In Hindu mythology, Mann represents the wisdom and intelligence that comes from deep understanding and introspection. The name is often given to children who are believed to possess these qualities. The name Mann carries the meaning “Mind, Intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mann usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mann belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mind, Intellect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mann total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
